changelog.name: 0.5 alpha
changelog.body:
**WaRevamp 0.5 alpha** brings a lot of new features such as refuse calls, time formatter, sticker features, brings some UI changes, bug fixes and a **lot of stuff**, enjoy!

### Bug fixes

- Works with **WhatsApp 2.26.45.13** and **WhatsApp Business 2.26.44.74**
- **Hide delivered tick**: messages are now answered the way WhatsApp itself answers them, so WhatsApp Web no longer shows them as read
- **Anti view-once**: view once messages you haven't opened no longer expire after 14 days (the ones that already expired stay expired)
- Blue ticks you hold back are no longer lost when WhatsApp or WhatsApp Business restarts, updates or goes back to an older version; they are still sent later. **Blue ticks on reply** sends all of them, also in long chats
- **Anti-delete**: a message you flipped back stays that way when the next message comes, in groups too
- GIFs keep their own size and frame rate, and never come out worse than WhatsApp's own
- Two stickers sent together now get WaRevamp utilities, like an album
- Turning a switch on for private chats no longer changes its Groups side
- Turning the module off in LSPosed, or taking WhatsApp out of its scope, now turns it off in an open WhatsApp too

### News

#### Privacy

- **Mark as read button**: sends the blue ticks held for that chat, from the chat's menu or the message bar, your pick
- **Mark as received button**: while Hide delivered tick is on, marks the chat's messages as received (two grey ticks, no blue)
- **Refuse calls**: the caller sees it ringing, declined, in another call, unavailable, can't be called or offline, your pick, with or without a notification for you; private chats and groups apart
- **Mark as seen**: Hide status views now keeps your views, and the status menu gets Mark as seen and Mark all as seen, inside one "WaRevamp" submenu
- **Show deleted time**: a Deletion time card for kept messages, in WaRevamp utilities
- **Hide forwarded**: messages you forward go as new ones, with no "Forwarded" label

#### Customization

- **Show seconds**: seconds, milliseconds or a format of your own in chats, the chats list, last seen and statuses, also for "2h"-style times and older dates
- **Name on the home screen**: your name, or your own text, where "WhatsApp" is, in WhatsApp's own title style, with one line under it
- **Admin icon**: in groups, a shield after an admin's name and a crown after the owner's *(on by default)*
- **Read state dot**: beside a received message's time, in WhatsApp and Business; red while the sender can't see it read, yellow while the read is on its way, green once they can
- **Open at last message**: chats always open at the last message *(on by default)*
- **First message button**: jump to a chat's first message
- **Remove show more**: long messages open whole
- **Save video notes**: save rounded video messages
- **Disable auto skip**: a status stays until you tap or swipe
- **Disable status in profile photo**: tapping a photo opens the profile, with no status ring
- **Save status**, improved: one Save option; a status with more than one thing to take opens a sheet where you tick what to save; Facebook and Instagram video links can be saved, and links copied
- **Increase pin limit**, improved: one switch on the Home screen page, 20 chats

#### Media

- **Stickers**: the ones you make carry your own title, creator and description, and can skip the white outline
- **Edit before sending**: change a sticker's title, creator and description before it goes, for that sticker only
- **No audio size limit**: send audio files over WhatsApp's limit
- **Preview media** now works for video notes, rounded like the message
- **Send audio as voice**, improved: while the audio is converted, a notification shows its progress, like the one WhatsApp shows when it sends media

#### Utilities

- **Anti-lag**: very long texts stop slowing WhatsApp, and on Infinix and Tecno the phone's AI writing bar stays out of it
- **Full compile** *(root)*: compiles WhatsApp ahead of time, which can make it a little faster (the gain may be small) and takes some more storage; **Compile after updates** does it again after each WhatsApp update
- **Schedule any time**: schedule a message for any time, without WhatsApp's 10-minute minimum

#### Props

- **Schedule message**: hold Send to schedule a message
- **Sticker sound**: stickers with sound; the other phone needs it too

#### The app

- Pick Global, WhatsApp or Business from a strip above the bottom bar; with one app installed it opens directly
- Categories fold into a side rail, with new icons
- **Privacy** has a page per topic (Ticks, Presence, Calls, Deleted messages) with a Private chats | Groups bar; **Customization** has Home screen, Conversation screen and Status screen pages; **Media** has Photos, Videos, Audio and Stickers pages
- The Home screen and Stickers pages show a preview of the result at the top
- Home and Report issue also show problems that happen while WhatsApp runs

---

Made by [@DarkerZap](https://t.me/DarkerZap) · [Channel](https://t.me/warevampmodule) · [Group](https://t.me/warevampgroup)

readme:
WaRevamp

An LSPosed module for WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business: hide ticks and typing, keep deleted and view once messages, save statuses, send media at your own quality, and more.

Download  ·  Channel  ·  Group

## Requirements - Android 9 or newer, rooted - LSPosed with the modern Xposed API (API 102) - WhatsApp 2.26.38.10 to 2.26.45.13 - WhatsApp Business 2.26.43.72 to 2.26.44.74 > A newer WhatsApp can break a feature until the next update. The app's Home shows what is missing, and **Report issue** sends us what we need to fix it. ## Install 1. Install the APK from [Releases](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/app.djzrevamp.wa/releases), or from the **Repository** tab of LSPosed Manager 2. In LSPosed, enable **WaRevamp** and tick WhatsApp, WhatsApp Business or both 3. Open WaRevamp and turn on what you want. Most options apply at once; the rest ask to restart WhatsApp ## Features The same categories as in the app. Tap one to open it.
  Privacy | Feature | What it does | |---|---| | **Hide delivered tick** | Others don't see that their messages reached you | | **Hide blue ticks** | Others don't see that you opened their messages | | **Blue ticks on reply** | Replying sends the blue ticks held for that chat | | **Mark as read button** | Sends the blue ticks held for that chat, from the chat's menu or the message bar | | **Mark as received button** | Marks a chat's messages as received: two grey ticks, no blue | | **Hide played voice notes** | Others don't see that you listened to their voice notes | | **Hide typing** · **Hide recording** | Nobody sees you writing or recording | | **Refuse calls** | Calls don't ring; the caller sees what you pick, with or without a notification for you | | **Anti-delete** | Keeps messages others delete; tap the button beside one to see the original | | **Show as deleted** | Kept messages look deleted until you tap the button | | **Show deleted time** | When a kept message was deleted | | **Anti-delete status** | Keeps statuses their author deletes | | **Delete for everyone time** | Delete for everyone up to 30 days, 60 days or with no limit | | **Hide status views** | Watch statuses without showing up as a viewer; send your view later with **Mark as seen** | | **Anti view-once** | View once photos, videos, voice and text open as often as you want, your own too, with a Save button; unopened ones no longer expire after 14 days | | **Hide forwarded** | Messages you forward go as new ones | Ticks, voice notes, typing, recording and calls can be set apart for private chats and for groups.
  Customization | Feature | What it does | |---|---| | **Name on the home screen** | Your name, or your own text, where "WhatsApp" is, in WhatsApp's own title style | | **Increase pin limit** | Pin up to 20 chats | | **WaRevamp utilities** | A button beside photos, videos, stickers, documents, audio, voice and deleted messages, and an entry in every message's menu | | **Admin icon** | A shield after an admin's name and a crown after the group owner's | | **Read state dot** | Shows whether the sender can see that you read a message | | **Open at last message** | Chats open at the last message, not where you left them | | **First message button** | Jump to a chat's first message | | **Remove show more** | Long messages open whole | | **Save video notes** | Save rounded video messages | | **Save status** | Photos, videos, voice, text and Facebook or Instagram video links, into Downloads | | **Disable auto skip** | A status stays until you tap or swipe | | **Show seconds** | Seconds, milliseconds or a format of your own, also for "2h"-style times and older dates | | **Disable status in profile photo** | Tapping a photo opens the profile, with no status ring |
  Media | Feature | What it does | |---|---| | **Increase photo limits** | Your own size and quality for the photos you send | | **Increase video limits** | Your own resolution, bitrate and frame rate for the videos you send | | **Avoid transcoding** | Videos go in their original resolution and format when possible | | **Re-encode limits** | A video that must be re-encoded goes at your limits | | **Open unsupported videos** | Send videos WhatsApp refuses to open | | **Status video length** | Status videos up to 180 seconds, or with no limit | | **Send audio as voice** | Each audio file goes as a voice message or as an audio file, your pick | | **No audio size limit** | Send audio files over WhatsApp's size limit | | **Music on status** | Post a song as a voice status | | **Use my info** · **Remove outline** | Stickers you make carry your own title and creator, with or without the white outline | | **Edit before sending** | Change a sticker's title, creator and description before it goes, for that sticker only | | **Media info** | A photo's or video's details, before and after sending | | **Preview media** | See a photo or video, video notes too, without downloading it | | **Download boost** | Big files download over several connections at once |
  Utilities | Feature | What it does | |---|---| | **Anti-lag** | Very long texts stop slowing WhatsApp | | **Full compile** · **Compile after updates** | Compiles WhatsApp ahead of time, again after each update; it can make it a little faster (the gain may be small) and takes some more storage (root) | | **Schedule any time** | Schedule a message for any time, without WhatsApp's 10-minute minimum |
  Props WhatsApp's own features that aren't out for everyone yet. | Feature | What it does | |---|---| | **View once text** | Hold Send to send a typed message as view once | | **Schedule message** | Hold Send to schedule a message | | **Rounded bubble tails** | WhatsApp's newer bubble look | | **Usernames** | WhatsApp's @username | | **Sticker sound** | Stickers with sound; the other phone needs it too |
## The app - Global defaults, plus settings of their own for WhatsApp and for WhatsApp Business - Home shows what each WhatsApp build supports, and **Report issue** shares your versions, your setup and a log - English and Português ## Credits WaRevamp was started by **Kaio Reis** ([its.madruga.warevamp](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/its.madruga.warevamp)) as the continuation of MdgWa. This version is the continuation of the [old WaRevamp](https://modules.lsposed.org/module/its.madruga.warevamp), now deprecated, and is now made by its new owner, me (**[@DarkerZap](https://t.me/DarkerZap)**).

下载  ·  频道  ·  群组

可能会破坏某项功能，直到下次更新为止。该应用程序的主页显示了缺少的内容，并且**报告问题**向我们发送了修复它所需的内容。 ## 安装 1. 从 [Releases](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/app.djzrevamp.wa/releases) 或 LSPod Manager 的 **Repository** 选项卡安装 APK 2. 在
